openai_compatible_gateway.detail: Authenticated /v1 gateway for chat completions, completions, and embeddings.

streaming.detail: Server-sent event streaming is proxied without response buffering.

native_tool_calls.detail: Tool orchestration is currently owned by the agent harness.

knossos_session_control.detail: Authenticated session board and Knossos control routes are available.

vram_leases.detail: Session-owned VRAM leases prevent surprise eviction by default.

context_discovery.detail: Per-model context limits are exposed in engine profiles.

verified_downloads.detail: Known aliases are pinned by SHA-256 and incomplete downloads are isolated.

hardware_recommendation.detail: Detected accelerator and host headroom select the highest-ranked checksum-pinned profile for chat, coding, or agent work.

one_action_setup.detail: cameo setup preflights policy and runtime, downloads a pinned model, verifies SHA-256, configures serving arguments, and starts on loopback by default.

scheduling.detail: Trust, health, locality, affinity, deadline, warm-model, and load-aware admission is available on /hub/dispatch.

device_pairing.detail: An operator creates a ten-minute one-time code; redemption issues a per-node 256-bit credential stored only as a hub-side digest. Node and hub identity state survives restart; removal durably revokes it. Certificate binding remains pending.

mutual_tls.detail: Hub-to-node callbacks require HTTPS but are not yet mutually authenticated with device certificates.

distributed_model_sharding.detail: Cameo routes whole inference requests; it does not shard one model execution across LAN nodes.

role_scoped_keys.detail: Consumer and operator credentials are separated and compared in constant time.

local_harness_bypass.detail: Keyless harness control is restricted to local transport in self-host posture.

request_rate_limits.detail: Bounded per-client fixed-window admission protects pairing, invalid credentials, inference, control, and public HTTP routes.

release_security_review.detail: Security regression tests exist; independent release review and platform certification remain pending.
